## Activity

During April 2024, North City Eye Clinic recorded 520 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading measures below. The capture total is presented as recorded, without adjustment or further interpretation.

## Image quality

Of the 520 captures, 11 were recorded as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.1 per cent. These figures describe the image quality outcome for the reporting period and are reported separately from the grading results.

## Grading

The grading results included 115 referable cases. The median lag was 2. This measure records the central interval reported for grading activity during April 2024. Together, the referable total and median lag provide the grading summary for North City Eye Clinic for the month.
